thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: cross-region routing errors detected — elevated 5xx and tail latency for requests originating in eu-west1/2 routed to us-west1. Impacting text-gen and chat endpoints. Auto-escalation to on-call.
PagerDuty: Paging Julian (on-call) for routing-anomaly-eu.
Julian: oncall ack. initial buzzer. can someone paste a summary of affected services?
ops-bot: Affected: /v1/generate (text-gen), /v1/chat. Start: 2026-04-02T09:14:02Z. Error rate ~6.8% from eu-west1/2 -> us-west1. Baseline <0.3%.
Nina: i see the same on our synthetic probes. eu-west1 -> us-west1 RTT jump 120ms -> 640ms. Also CPU on us-west1 frontend spiked.
Zoe: rolling checks: any recent routing push? deploy-bot, did we do a geo config change?
deploy-bot: Rollout job geo-express-2026-04-02-01 completed at 09:12:57Z. Change: new region-expression mapping to support abbreviated region names. Applied by automations@ci.
Julian: can we inspect the expression mapping? `routingctl show policy geo-express --json | jq .mappings`
Nina: output snippet:
```
["eu-west1","eu-west2","eu-central1"] => ["us-west1","eu-local-edges","eu-central1"]
```
Nina: looks like a shift: eu-west1 -> us-west1, eu-west2 -> eu-local, etc. that ordering is wrong.
Julian: that is the bug. the new abbreviation parsing trimmed a prefix and the mapping array drifted. catastrophic for geo pinning.
Zoe: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout job, 2) create region-level override to steer eu-west1/eu-west2 to eu-local pools, 3) reduce steering DNS TTL to 15s to speed convergence, 4) monitor, 5) open CS comms.
Julian: pausing rollout: `routingctl rollout pause geo-express-2026-04-02-01`
deploy-bot: Rollout geo-express-2026-04-02-01 paused at 09:19:11Z.
Nina: creating override: `routingctl override create --region eu-west1 --target eu-local-pool --ttl 30s --reason "emergency drain"`
Nina: override applied for eu-west1 and eu-west2.
Zoe: lowering steer DNS TTL: `dnsmgr set-ttl steer.eu-west.redwood.net 15`
Zoe: TTL change pushed to auth at 09:20:03Z.
Julian: early telemetry: 5xx dropped 6.8% -> 1.7% within 45s of overrides. p95 latency improved from 640ms -> 210ms, still slightly above normal (140ms).
CS-Liaison: customer hit list: FinchHealth (SLA), NovaApps (high-volume), BetaCorp (trial). CS notified; preparing interim note.
Julian: good. we should also check whether any long-lived DNS caches (ISP caches) will keep hitting old mapping. Nina, can you estimate residual traffic window given previous TTL=120s?
Nina: with 120s TTL and some ISP caches, residue could persist up to ~5 minutes for a small fraction. most clients re-resolve within ~2 mins.
Zoe: rolling deploy note: the abbreviation parser change added a fallback that strips hyphens and lowercases; unit test missed a multi-region reorder case. I'm reverting that patch and adding a stricter parser.
Zoe: revert commit queued: `git revert f3b9a1e` -> will be deployed to rollout service now.
deploy-bot: revert deployed to rollout service at 09:22:40Z.
Julian: add guard: block region-expression changes that modify explicit pin targets for existing region IDs. Zoe, add to quickguard.
Zoe: on it. implementing a validation that compares pre/post mapping diffs and fails if any region ID gains a cross-continental pin. ETA ~3h for deploy.
Nina: metrics now show 5xx at 0.5% @09:25:10Z. p95 150ms. trending to baseline.
Julian: good. I'll create an incident channel #incident-4456789000 and add this thread there for full coordination.
CS-Liaison: interim note sent to affected customers at 09:26Z. offered status updates and postmortem.
Julian: handing off monitoring to Zoe for next 6h. Zoe, take oncall follow until 15:30 UTC?
Zoe: taking. will watch for flaps.
Julian: action items:
- Zoe: harden region-expression parser + add mapping diff guard (ETA 3h)
- Nina: collect probe screenshots, netflow dumps for us-west1 path and eu edges (ETA 90m)
- CS-Liaison: track SLO hits and customer replies, send FTC note if >1% of requests for a paid SLO (ETA 30m)
- Julian: open PM ticket PM-INC-4456789000 for RCA, schedule RCA within 48h
Zoe: quick observation: the rollout job had no staged canary for abbreviated-parsing change; we should mandate expression parsing changes to be canaried on 5% traffic first. adding to ticket.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: routing-health alert cleared at 09:33:45Z. No new pages.
Julian: leaving page open for a 30m stable window before resolve. will annotate rollout job with rollback reason + timeline.
CS-Liaison: customers acknowledged interim note; FinchHealth requested phone call, scheduled for 10:00 UTC.
Nina: saving logs: `scp logs/us-west1/frontends/* /tmp/incident-4456789000/` then uploading to the incident ticket.
Zoe: note for postmortem: consider a safety check that prevents mapping arrays from being applied if positions shift relative to explicit region IDs (i.e., require keyed mappings rather than positional arrays).
Julian: agreed. high-value takeaway: never rely on array position for region->target mappings. must be explicit key/value.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: stable window reached at 09:59:11Z. Incident cleared.
Zoe: will keep monitoring for 6h and then hand back to normal rotation.
Julian: thanks everyone. closing pager and wrapping up with PM ticket and CS follow-ups.
